# telnyx_terms_of_service_status (Data Source)

Which Terms of Service the account has agreed to.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `product_type` (String) Telnyx product the Terms of Service apply to. One of `branded_calling`, `number_reputation`.

### Read-Only

- `agreed_at` (String) When you accepted the terms, or null if you have not.
- `agreed_version` (String) Version the user previously agreed to (may be older than `current_terms_version`). `null` if the user has never agreed.
- `agreement_required` (Boolean) `true` when the user must agree to the latest version before using the product. Equivalent to `!has_agreed`.
- `current_terms_version` (String) Latest published version of the ToS for this product.
- `has_agreed` (Boolean) `true` if the user has agreed to the latest version.
